name: BULK SMS PLANS SMS Notifications
author: Prince Malik

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to send custom SMS messages and WhatsApp notifications for various WooCommerce order statuses, including New Order, Pending Order, Processing Order, On Hold Order, Completed Order, Cancelled Order, Failed Order, Refunded Order, and Checkout OTP. It also maintains a history of sent SMS messages for easy tracking.

Features

– Custom SMS sending for WooCommerce orders.
– WhatsApp notifications for different order statuses.
– SMS history logging.
– OTP verification during checkout.
– Easy configuration and integration with WooCommerce.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/custom-sms-whatsapp-notifications directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Settings->Custom SMS & WhatsApp’ screen to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce order statuses?

Yes, it supports notifications for New Order, Pending Order, Processing Order, On Hold Order, Completed Order, Cancelled Order, Failed Order, Refunded Order, and Checkout OTP.

Can I customize the SMS and WhatsApp messages?

Yes, the plugin allows you to customize messages for each order status in the settings page.

Is an additional SMS provider required?

Yes, you need an SMS provider to send SMS notifications. Follow the plugin documentation to configure your SMS provider.
